messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing-policies service reports sudden increase in cross-region fallbacks (-> eu-west-1). 5xxs observed in hosted API, start times ~2123456700. Auto-detect flagged deprecated field usage in latest policy schema rollout. paging @alice_oncall :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: saw it. pinging runtime and s/reliability. impact? any customers 5xx?

ben_runtime: looking. initial metrics: fallback rate spiked from 0.7% -> 27% in last 2m. latency up ~150ms p95. Some requests returned model-variant-mismatch errors before fallback.

carol_sre: I have trace snippets showing repeated region failover loops for some tenant routes. requests go us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 then timeout. looks like policy default target changed to deprecated "region_affinity: legacy" field that maps to drain behavior.

alice_oncall: @ben_runtime can you confirm last deploy touched routing schema?

ben_runtime: yes — we pushed config-schema v1.12.0 at 2123456600. Migration script removed a default for the new 'preferred_region' key, leaving unspecified routes to infer legacy affinity (which forces region drain -> fallback). Commit: `git@repo:configs#9f3a2b`.

dave_product: this was from the canary schema change we shipped to reduce explicit routing fields. we didn't expect unspecified -> legacy-affinity. we rolled the change to 20% canary.

elaine_cs: customers reporting increased 503s. Support ticket P-7429 open (enterprise customer: Lobula). they notice timeouts in their llm calls ~10:02 UTC.

frank_eng: adding logs. from router-service:```
[2123456727] route_apply tenant=lobula route_id=rt-82 config_v=1.12.0 fields={preferred_region: null, region_affinity: legacy}
[2123456730] dispatch to region eu-west-1 (fallback) -> kvcache miss
[2123456732] timeout waiting for connection pool
[2123456733] fallback loop attempt=3 -> us-east-1 backoff
```

carol_sre: probable root cause: schema migration used `DEFAULT_LEGACY_AFFINITY=true` when preferred_region omitted. So unspecified routes got treated as legacy-drain targets. That combined with health-check jitter caused oscillation.

alice_oncall: mitigation plan?

ben_runtime: immediate mitigation: revert migration to reintroduce explicit default 'preferred_region: us-east-1' for existing routes. I can push patch to config service and trigger a rolling config sync. Will do now.

ben_runtime: (running) `kubectl exec -it config-sync-0 -- /app/sync --upsert-file /tmp/patch.json`

ben_runtime: patch content:```
{ "op": "replace", "path": "/routes/*/preferred_region", "value": "us-east-1" }
```

ops-bot: job config-sync/patch-2123456789 started on config-sync-0

carol_sre: also recommend disabling canary rollout and aborting v1.12.0 until we have a safe migration path.

dave_product: aborting canary now. sending rollback command to rollout-service.

frank_eng: watch logs for decrease in fallback rate. tailing router metrics.

alice_oncall: paging escalation: @carol_sre you have the pager; handing off at 10:12 UTC in 5 minutes. I'll coordinate with support on customer comms.

carol_sre: got it, standing by.

ben_runtime: config patch applied to 85% routes. config-sync reports success for most tenants, some edge ones failing due to custom route templates; will handle those manually.

ben_runtime: working on manual fixes for tenants with templated routes: using `admin-console` to set preferred_region for the 12 failing routes.

elaine_cs: notifying Lobula support contact: "we see elevated fallbacks and are rolling a rollback to restore region affinity. We'll follow up with timeline."

ops-bot: rollout-service: abort canary for schema v1.12.0 - acknowledged

frank_eng: metrics update: fallback rate dropped from 27% -> 3.5% in 4m after patch. 5xx rate trending down.

carol_sre: still seeing a small oscillation on a subset (tenants using dynamic-mesh). hypothesis: their policies reference deprecated flag `region_affinity: legacy` explicitly. we'll create a transformation to map legacy -> preferred_region explicitly instead of relying on inference.

ben_runtime: creating migration job: `scripts/migrate_legacy_affinity --map=preferred_region` targeting dynamic-mesh tenants. planning maintenance window 10:30-10:45 UTC to avoid churn.

alice_oncall: CS update: Lobula reported service mostly recovered, but they saw a 7% error slice for 8 minutes. They want RCA and timeline.

dave_product: agree we need RCA. action items: (1) revert and stop canary (done), (2) migration job to explicitly backfill preferred_region (in progress), (3) add validation on config service to reject unspecified preferred_region when schema v1.12 expects explicit mapping, (4) add unit test for migration logic.

carol_sre: I'm opening an incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps. assigning postmortem leads: @dave_product and @ben_runtime.

elaine_cs: I'll follow up with affected customers with timeline and MCC (Mitigation, Cause, Current status).

frank_eng: small follow-up: recommend a circuit-breaker in router to prevent immediate cross-region retries more than 2x per request; that would limit oscillation while we fix config. filing an RFC.

alice_oncall: handoff complete. @carol_sre you own the on-call for next 3 hours, ping me if escalation needed. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. created incident-2123456789.assignments: owners=[carol_sre,dave_product,ben_runtime]. severity=sev2

carol_sre: logging timeline notes into incident doc. will run deep-dive after containment.

ben_runtime: follow-up tasks created in tracker: CFG-1290 (migration safe-guard), CFG-1291 (config validation), RTE-445 (router cb).

elaine_cs: Lobula notified with timeline and mitigation summary. awaiting response on SLA impact request.

frank_eng: metrics stable for 26m. closing coordination thread, moving to incident doc for postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: monitoring only. next update in 30m or on changes.
